Books are too important to be left to authors. If you’re even remotely protocol-pilled, this is a great opportunity. Come along and join the fun.

That’s just five general non-fiction books we know of, for a field that clearly deserves at least forty. And probably closer to four hundred. Look at the hundreds of books published about nations-states or corporations for instance. Protocols are at least as significant a concept today, and only poised to become ever more significant. But so far, they have been criminally under-theorized.
